Container.Name: ARTscale
Container.Overview: Self-hosted Tailscale control server (headscale) with a web console for reaching customer networks on demand. Turn each customer's subnet routes on and off, with a conflict guard for customers that share the same subnets and auto-off timers. Works with the standard Tailscale apps. Setup: point two Nginx Proxy Manager hosts at this container (hs.yourdomain -> Headscale port with Websockets on; artscale.yourdomain -> WebUI port), forward UDP 3478 on your router to Unraid, then get the setup code from the container log.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: ARTscale web console. Point your Nginx Proxy Manager host for artscale.yourdomain here.

Config.Name: Headscale port
Config.Description: Tailscale control server and relay. Point your Nginx Proxy Manager host for hs.yourdomain here, with Websockets Support on.

Config.Name: STUN port
Config.Description: Relay STUN. Must stay 3478 and be port-forwarded (UDP) from your router to Unraid.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: headscale database and keys, ARTscale settings and activity log, and the auto-created API key. Back this up.

Config.Name: Public headscale URL
Config.Description: The public HTTPS address every Tailscale device uses, served through Nginx Proxy Manager, e.g. https://hs.example.com. Hard to change later.

Config.Name: Public IPv4 for relay
Config.Description: Optional. Leave empty to look it up through DNS (best if your IP changes). Set it only if your public IP is static.

Config.Name: Public IPv6 for relay
Config.Description: Optional. Only if you have a public IPv6 address.

Config.Name: Trusted proxy networks
Config.Description: Where Nginx Proxy Manager's requests come from (comma-separated CIDRs), so login lockout sees real visitor IPs. Add NPM's own IP if it runs on br0.

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: auto = secure over HTTPS (through NPM) and still works over plain HTTP on your LAN. true = HTTPS only. false = never.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the appdata files (99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the appdata files (100 = users).
